description: This file defines the ManufacturerDescription class, which models the localized description of a manufacturer, including related attributes such as URL, click statistics, and the associated Manufacturer entity. It is an Entity class mapped to the MANUFACTURER_DESCRIPTION table in a database schema.

classes.name: ManufacturerDescription
classes.description: Entity class extending Description that represents a localized manufacturer description with additional metadata such as URL and click statistics.

methods.name: ManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new instance of ManufacturerDescription.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the manufacturer description.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the manufacturer.

methods.name: getUrlClicked
methods.description: Returns the number of times the URL has been clicked.

methods.name: setUrlClicked
methods.description: Sets the number of URL clicks.

methods.name: getDateLastClick
methods.description: Returns the date of the last URL click.

methods.name: setDateLastClick
methods.description: Sets the date of the last URL click.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the Manufacturer entity associated with this description.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Associates a Manufacturer entity with this description.
